xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RemarksForExchangeNotForWebsit:
This is to inform the Exchange that in the Integrated Corporate Governance Report for the quarter ended 30th September, 2025 filed on 18th October, 2025, an inadvertent error was identified. In Annexure I Composition of the Board of Directors, the category of Mr. Pradeep Madhavrao Chavan was mistakenly selected as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director from the dropdown list instead of Non-Executive, Independent Director.
Mr. Pradeep Madhavrao Chavan has been duly appointed as an Independent Director, and the requisite disclosures and filings were made at the time of his appointment. Further, in all previous quarters, except for the quarter ended 30th September, 2025, his category has been correctly reported as Non-Executive, Independent Director.
The aforesaid discrepancy is purely technical and typographical in nature. The Exchange is requested to take the same on record and oblige.
